_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With the score moving ±2+ points in 0 of 37 windows, this is a compressed coil where HOLD with conviction is the statistically skilled call, though the analyst's forward lean toward Disbelief is the most logical adjacent rung if spot accumulation eventually breaks the range.
next_move.brains_agree: No — the analyst calls HOLD with medium conviction citing lethal directionality in coils, while the narrative writer implies an imminent violent reversal; the analyst's higher-trust pattern read overrides the narrative's bullish framing.
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC funding rises above 0.015% with ETF flows sustained above 80 and btc_momentum_30d breaks above 60
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 20 with DXY breaking 101 and btc_exchange_reserves_pct_30d drops below 50
